# third_party

Code in this folder was not written for Kickoff. It is copied unchanged so the scoring circuits can
be checked with an evaluator that Kickoff did not write.

## tap02_reference.py

The reference implementation of TAP-02, "Circuit Netlist Format and Evaluation Semantics": the
decoder, well-formedness check, one-beat evaluator and bit packing for TapeOut circuits.
